title: Delivery Manager
summary: A delivery manager in an IT services company owns delivery for one or more client accounts: several project teams, the client relationship, and the account's revenue and margin. Project managers and technical leads report to them, and they report to the account or delivery head.
dailyDuties: Review status, risks and dependencies across the account's project teams
Track revenue, billing and margin against the account plan
Plan staffing and fill open positions with the resourcing team
Handle client escalations and agree recovery plans
Run delivery reviews with client IT leaders
Prepare estimates and statements of work for renewals and new work
Coach project managers and technical leads

skills.expectation: Own revenue, billing and margin for one or more client accounts
Run several project teams under one governance rhythm with RAID logs and status reports
Hold project managers to scope, schedule and plan across the account
Plan staffing, the team pyramid and fulfilment of open positions
Handle client escalations and drive recovery plans to closure
Shape proposals, effort estimates and statements of work for renewals and new work
Run delivery in agile or hybrid models across teams
Lead project managers and technical leads, often teams of 50 or more
Own the delivery relationship with client IT leaders and the account team
Present delivery reviews and status to client and internal leadership
Negotiate rates, change requests and contract terms with the client
Help grow the account with account plans and new opportunities
Report SLAs on support and managed-services work
Run application support work on ITIL processes
Deliver inside a SAFe release train
Know the client's banking or insurance domain

certifications.why: Most-asked project credential for delivery managers in Indian IT services
Named as an alternative to PMP, common on UK and European accounts
Useful when the account includes application support or managed services
